svg.text: PROJECT M159 — DUAL-DOMAIN ACTIVE DIRECTORY & HYBRID IDENTITY ARCHITECTURE
Authentik → Windows AD Sync (dc1.cloud-ah.local) • LAM → Samba 4 AD Management (cloud-ah.com)

g.text: All internal containers inter-communicate via private bridge
Allowed LDAPS (636) to AWS DC1 & Cloud Samba DC2
Let's Encrypt certificates managed by Nginx Proxy Manager
Assigned across GL, Informatik, Buchhaltung & Aussendienst OUs
Realm: CLOUD-AH.COM • NetBIOS: CLOUD-AH • Base DN: DC=cloud-ah,DC=com
Services: LDAPS (636), Kerberos (88), DNS (53) • Managed via LAM
Samba 4 AD Architecture & LAM Management Integration
Directly manages Samba 4 AD users (Daniel Brandt, John Doe) and groups
Connects securely via LDAPS Port 636 from eVPS Docker host
Maintains contractor accounts outside of internal corporate AD
Prevents sensitive internal schema pollution while allowing federated access
• External users cannot access internal OUs without explicit trust permissions
• Authentication requests cross-validated over Bidirectional External Trust
• Managed via LAM crossing through DC1 mid-stack corridor
Authorized cross-domain access without merging LDAP trees
Kerberos / NTLM Cross-Realm Trust Endpoint Sync between dc1.cloud-ah.local & cloud-ah.com
